p-value = 8.32e-72

A Pearson chi-square test of independence (with Yates' continuity correction, df = 1) was applied to the 2×2 contingency table of m6A methylation status (sig = m6A Hyper + m6A Hypo, 1,191 genes; no sig = 11,563) versus differential expression status (DEG = Up + Down, 963 genes; no-DEG = 11,791) in the bladder cancer dataset (n = 12,754 genes). The table was [[sig×DEG 246, sig×no-DEG 945], [no-sig×DEG 717, no-sig×no-DEG 10,846]]. The test yields χ² = 321.1047, p = 8.32e-72, i.e., m6A methylation status and differential expression status are strongly dependent (non-independent). Footnote for transparency: without continuity correction χ² = 323.1721, p = 2.95e-72; Fisher's exact two-sided p = 8.22e-54 — the Yates-corrected value is the committed answer.
